basic_details.short_information: Master Control Facility (MCF), Hassan, ISRO Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27 Notification has been released on 13 July 2026 on the official website. A total of 45 vacancies have been announced for Graduate Apprentice Trainee (GAT) and Technician Apprentice Trainee (TAT) posts under the MCF Hassan Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27.

application_fee.details: The notification does not specify any application fee for the apprenticeship categories.

qualification.details: Candidates must meet the following essential requirements to be considered eligible. | Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply. Only candidates who passed their qualifying examination as regular students are eligible. Candidates who completed their Degree/Diploma during 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, or 2026 are eligible, provided they join within 5 years of acquiring the degree (calculated from the month and year of passing as stated on the degree certificate). Candidates who passed before 2022 are not eligible. If this 5-year window lapses by the time of offer, the candidate will not be offered training even if empanelled or waitlisted. Ex-apprentices, or candidates currently undergoing apprenticeship, or those with one year or more of job experience in the government/public/private sector as on the date of joining, are not eligible. Candidates who have done sandwich courses, private degrees, or short-term/certificate courses, or who are pursuing higher studies (e.g., B.E./B.Tech while applying as a Diploma apprentice, or M.E./M.Tech while applying as a Graduate apprentice), are not acceptable. Combining apprenticeship with any other institution is not permitted. | post category: Qualification Required | gat (mechanical/electrical & electronics/electronics & communication/computer science/civil): B.E./B.Tech in the respective discipline from a recognized Indian University | gat (library science): Graduation in Library Science/Library & Information Science (AICTE/UGC approved) from a recognized Indian University | gat (general stream): Degree (B.A./B.Com./B.Sc.) from a recognized university in India | tat (mechanical/electrical & electronics/electronics & communication/civil): Diploma in Engineering in the respective discipline, awarded by a recognized State Board | tat (library science): Diploma in Library Science, awarded by a recognized State Board | tat (commercial practice): Diploma in Commercial Practice, awarded by a recognized State Board

selection_process: All applications received will be screened

and selection panels will be prepared based on the candidates' academic scores at Degree/Diploma level. Induction of apprentices against vacant training positions will be made strictly based on their position in the merit panel. Only selected candidates will be informed through an offer letter sent by email. Only shortlisted/empanelled candidates will be called for document verification
subject to the availability of vacant apprenticeship positions. Candidates shortlisted for document verification are not eligible for Travelling Allowance.
how_to_apply: Register on the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) portal at nats.education.gov.in and obtain a NATS Enrolment Number.
Download and fill the Application Form (Annexure-1) attached with the official circular.
Attach scanned copies of all required documents listed above in PDF format.
Email the completed application along with documents to [email protected], with the subject line "Application for Graduate/Technician Apprenticeship Category".
Ensure the application reaches within the stipulated last date of 3 August 2026.
important_instructions: All correspondence with candidates will be done through email only; MCF, Hassan will not be responsible for any loss of email due to an invalid/wrong email ID provided by the candidate, or delivery to a spam/bulk mail folder. Candidates are responsible for downloading and printing their own application form/offer letter. Non-registered candidates on the NATS portal are likely to have their applications rejected. Any discrepancy found in name, age, Diploma/Degree percentage, year of passing, or caste/tribe details at any stage will be treated as disqualification. No interim correspondence will be entertained, and canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification. Selected candidates must submit a Medical Fitness Certificate at the time of joining and execute a contract of Apprenticeship Training as per the Apprentices Act, 1961. Apprentices will have no claim whatsoever for regular employment in ISRO or any other Centre/Unit of ISRO/Department of Space after completion of the training period.

Candidates holding a B.E./B.Tech degree can also explore more Engineering Government Jobs and ISRO Recruitment opportunities across India. Diploma holders looking for similar apprenticeship openings can check the latest Apprentice Jobs 2026 and Diploma Government Jobs. Candidates based in Karnataka can also browse more Karnataka Government Jobs and Hassan District Jobs for upcoming vacancies.

content_sections.heading: MCF Hassan Apprentice Vacancy 2026 Details
content_sections.text: The 45 vacancies are distributed across the Graduate Apprentice Trainee (GAT) and Technician Apprentice Trainee (TAT) categories as follows. Note: The notification lists a combined figure of 14 posts across the Bachelor of Arts, Bachelor of Commerce, and Bachelor of Science streams without a further post-wise split.

content_sections.heading: MCF Hassan Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the following essential requirements to be considered eligible. Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply. Only candidates who passed their qualifying examination as regular students are eligible. Candidates who completed their Degree/Diploma during 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, or 2026 are eligible, provided they join within 5 years of acquiring the degree (calculated from the month and year of passing as stated on the degree certificate). Candidates who passed before 2022 are not eligible. If this 5-year window lapses by the time of offer, the candidate will not be offered training even if empanelled or waitlisted. Ex-apprentices, or candidates currently undergoing apprenticeship, or those with one year or more of job experience in the government/public/private sector as on the date of joining, are not eligible. Candidates who have done sandwich courses, private degrees, or short-term/certificate courses, or who are pursuing higher studies (e.g., B.E./B.Tech while applying as a Diploma apprentice, or M.E./M.Tech while applying as a Graduate apprentice), are not acceptable. Combining apprenticeship with any other institution is not permitted.

content_sections.heading: MCF Hassan Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: All applications received will be screened, and selection panels will be prepared based on the candidates' academic scores at Degree/Diploma level. Induction of apprentices against vacant training positions will be made strictly based on their position in the merit panel. Only selected candidates will be informed through an offer letter sent by email. Only shortlisted/empanelled candidates will be called for document verification, subject to the availability of vacant apprenticeship positions. Candidates shortlisted for document verification are not eligible for Travelling Allowance.

content_sections.heading: MCF Hassan Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Documents Required
content_sections.text: Duly filled Application Form (Annexure-1) SSLC/10th Standard Marks Card/Certificate PUC/12th Standard Marks Card/Certificate Degree/Diploma Marks Cards of all semesters/years Degree/Diploma Certificate/Provisional Certificate NATS Enrolment Number and registration copy At the time of document verification, original documents including proof of date of birth, all mark sheets, educational certificates, and caste/tribe/disability certificate (as applicable) must be produced.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MCF Hassan Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Register on the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) portal at nats.education.gov.in and obtain a NATS Enrolment Number. Download and fill the Application Form (Annexure-1) attached with the official circular. Attach scanned copies of all required documents listed above in PDF format. Email the completed application along with documents to [email protected] , with the subject line "Application for Graduate/Technician Apprenticeship Category". Ensure the application reaches within the stipulated last date of 3 August 2026.

Candidates are responsible for downloading and printing their own application form/offer letter. Non-registered candidates on the NATS portal are likely to have their applications rejected. Any discrepancy found in name, age, Diploma/Degree percentage, year of passing, or caste/tribe details at any stage will be treated as disqualification. No interim correspondence will be entertained, and canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification. Selected candidates must submit a Medical Fitness Certificate at the time of joining and execute a contract of Apprenticeship Training as per the Apprentices Act, 1961. Apprentices will have no claim whatsoever for regular employment in ISRO or any other Centre/Unit of ISRO/Department of Space after completion of the training period. Candidates holding a B.E./B.Tech degree can also explore more Engineering Government Jobs and ISRO Recruitment opportunities across India. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in MCF Hassan Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 45 vacancies across Graduate Apprentice Trainee (GAT) and Technician Apprentice Trainee (TAT) categories

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for MCF Hassan Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 3 August 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the stipend for MCF Hassan apprentices?
faq.answer: GAT apprentices receive ₹12,300/- per month, and TAT apprentices receive ₹10,900/- per month.

faq.question: Q4. Is NATS registration mandatory for MCF Hassan apprenticeship?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates must register on the NATS portal (nats.education.gov.in) and provide their enrolment number.

faq.question: Q5. What is the duration of the apprenticeship training at MCF Hassan?
faq.answer: The training duration is 12 months (1 year) from the date of joining.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for MCF Hassan Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted only through email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for MCF Hassan Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on screening and merit panels prepared from candidates' academic scores at Degree/Diploma level; only selected candidates are informed by offer letter via email.
